items.title: Trio Sonata in E minor, Op. 3 No. 2
items.notes: Print (c. 1757): for two German flutes or two violins with a thorough bass; recorded on two flutes

items.title: Trio Sonata in D major, Op. 3 No. 3
items.notes: Print (c. 1757): for two German flutes or two violins with a thorough bass; recorded on two flutes

items.title: Fuga prima
items.notes: Four-part fugue from a 1602 dance collection; the Armida Quartett also record the Fuga seconda

items.title: Fuga secunda
items.notes: Four-part fugue; its IMSLP page (four instruments) was outside the census; the Armida Quartett record it

items.title: String Quartet in B minor, Op. 33 No. 1, Hob. III:37
items.notes: Opens as if in D major before settling in B minor

items.title: String Quartet in C major, Op. 33 No. 3, Hob. III:39 ("The Bird")
items.notes: Grace-note 'birdsong' for violin 1; the trio is a duet for the two violins

items.title: String Quartet in G major, Op. 33 No. 5, Hob. III:41 ("How Do You Do?")
items.notes: Opens with a quiet cadence figure that gave the nickname; variations finale

items.title: String Quartet in F-sharp minor, Op. 50 No. 4, Hob. III:47
items.notes: Rare key; the finale is a fugue

items.title: String Quartet in G major, Op. 76 No. 1, Hob. III:75
items.notes: Cello states the first theme alone; Presto minuet is a scherzo

items.title: String Quartet in B-flat major, Op. 76 No. 4, Hob. III:78 ("Sunrise")
items.notes: Violin 1 melody rises over held chords at the opening

items.title: String Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 76 No. 6, Hob. III:80
items.notes: Fantasia slow movement; minuet with a scale-based Alternativo

items.title: String Quartet in G major, Op. 77 No. 1, Hob. III:81
items.notes: Presto minuet is a scherzo; one of Haydn's last two completed quartets

items.title: String Quartet in F major, Op. 77 No. 2, Hob. III:82
items.notes: Haydn's last completed quartet; minuet placed second

items.title: Piano Trio in B-flat major, Hob. XV:38
items.notes: Early three-movement trio; the cello part, marked ad lib. in some editions, doubles the bass

items.title: Piano Trio in F major, Hob. XV:39
items.notes: Five short movements, mostly arranged from Haydn's early keyboard divertimenti

items.title: Piano Trio in G major, Hob. XV:5
items.notes: Opens with an Adagio; the authentic trio of Forster's Op. 40 set (the other two are probably Pleyel's)

items.title: Piano Trio in D major, Hob. XV:7
items.notes: Opens with a set of variations

items.title: Piano Trio in A major, Hob. XV:9
items.notes: Two movements: an expressive Adagio and a Vivace

items.title: Piano Trio in E-flat major, Hob. XV:11
items.notes: Two movements; the second a Tempo di menuetto

items.title: Piano Trio in F major, Hob. XV:17
items.notes: Written for flute, cello and keyboard; two movements, ending with a Tempo di menuetto

items.title: Piano Trio in E-flat major, Hob. XV:22
items.notes: Expansive late trio: Allegro moderato, Poco adagio, Allegro

items.title: Piano Trio in D minor, Hob. XV:23
items.notes: Opens with a Molto andante in D minor; Adagio ma non troppo and Vivace follow

items.title: Piano Trio in F-sharp minor, Hob. XV:26
items.notes: Rare key; the Adagio is the slow movement of Symphony No. 102

items.title: Piano Trio in E-flat minor, Hob. XV:31
items.notes: Two movements; the finale, nicknamed 'Jacob's Dream', puts the violin high

items.title: Piano Trio in E-flat major, Hob. XV:29
items.notes: Ends with a fast German dance (Allemande); dedicated to Therese Bartolozzi

items.title: London Trio No. 2 in G major, Hob. IV:2
items.notes: Two flutes and cello; Andante with variations and a short Allegro

items.title: London Trio No. 4 in G major, Hob. IV:4
items.notes: Two flutes and cello; a single Allegro movement

items.title: Flute Quartet in D major, Op. 5 No. 1, Hob. II:D9
items.notes: Doubtful work printed as Haydn's Op. 5 by Hummel (c. 1767); recorded under his name. Flute leads

items.title: Flute Quartet in G major, Op. 5 No. 2, Hob. II:G4
items.notes: Doubtful work printed as Haydn's Op. 5 by Hummel (c. 1767); recorded under his name. Flute leads

items.title: Flute Quartet in D major, Op. 5 No. 3, Hob. II:D10
items.notes: Doubtful work printed as Haydn's Op. 5 by Hummel (c. 1767); recorded under his name. Flute leads

items.title: Flute Quartet in D major, Op. 5 No. 5, Hob. II:D11
items.notes: Doubtful work printed as Haydn's Op. 5 by Hummel (c. 1767); recorded under his name. Flute leads

items.title: Concertino in G major, Hob. XIV:13
items.notes: Probably authentic (Grove); concertante keyboard with two violins and bass

items.title: Divertimento in F major, Hob. XIV:9
items.notes: Keyboard with two violins and bass; Allegro, Menuet, Allegro molto

items.title: Concertino in C major, Hob. XIV:11
items.notes: Concertante keyboard with two violins and bass; Moderato, Adagio, Allegro

items.title: Concertino in C major, Hob. XIV:12
items.notes: Concertante keyboard with two violins and bass; Allegro, Adagio, Finale

items.title: Divertimento in G major, Hob. II:9
items.notes: Haydn's 'Divertimento a nove stromenti': two oboes, two horns, two violins, two violas and bass

items.title: Divertimento in F major, Hob. II:20
items.notes: 'Divertimento a nove stromenti' for oboes, horns, two violins, two violas and bass; long Adagio

items.title: Divertimento in G major, Hob. II:G1
items.notes: Authorship not certain (Hoboken appendix number); Landon edited it as Haydn's from three copies

items.title: Divertimento in F major, Hob. II:16
items.notes: Haydn's 'Divertimento a otto': two violins with cors anglais, bassoons and horns, no bass string

items.title: Divertimento in D major, Hob. II:8
items.notes: For two flutes, two horns, two violins and bass; long Adagio at its centre

items.title: Cassation in D major, Hob. II:D22
items.notes: Four horns with violin, viola and bass; Hoboken appendix number, authorship not fully certain

items.title: String Trio in E major, Hob. V:1
items.notes: Adagio, Allegro and Tempo di menuetto, the slow-fast-minuet plan of the early trios

items.title: String Trio in F major, Hob. V:2
items.notes: Adagio, Allegro and Tempo di menuetto; violin 1 carries the melody over violin 2 and cello

items.title: String Trio in E-flat major, Hob. V:6
items.notes: Opens with a brief Scherzo (Presto), followed by an Allegro moderato and a Menuet

items.title: String Trio in A major, Hob. V:7
items.notes: Two movements: Moderato and a Tempo di menuetto with variations

items.title: String Trio in E-flat major, Hob. V:11
items.notes: Two movements: Moderato and Tempo di menuetto

items.title: String Trio in B-flat major, Hob. V:13
items.notes: Adagio, Allegro and a Moderato finale

items.title: String Trio in D major, Hob. V:15
items.notes: Haydn's earliest dated trio; Adagio, Allegro, Minuet with a D-minor trio

items.title: String Trio in C major, Hob. V:16
items.notes: Allegro, Minuet with a C-minor trio, Presto finale

items.title: String Trio in E-flat major, Hob. V:17
items.notes: Allegro, Minuet with a C-minor trio, Presto finale

items.title: String Trio in B-flat major, Hob. V:18
items.notes: Allegro moderato, Minuet and a Presto finale

items.title: String Trio in E major, Hob. V:19
items.notes: Adagio, Allegro and Tempo di menuetto

items.title: String Trio in G major, Hob. V:20
items.notes: Allegro, Minuet with a G-minor trio, Presto finale

items.title: String Trio in D major, Hob. V:21
items.notes: Opens with an Adagio siciliano, then Allegro and Menuet

items.title: String Trio in D major, Hob. V:D1
items.notes: Two movements, Moderato and Tempo di menuetto; authorship not proven (lettered Hoboken number)

items.title: String Trio in G major, Hob. V:G1
items.notes: Allegro molto, Minuet with a G-minor trio, Presto; authorship not proven (lettered Hoboken number)

items.title: String Trio in F major, Hob. V:F1
items.notes: Allegro moderato, Minuet with an F-minor trio, Presto; authorship not proven (lettered Hoboken number)

items.title: String Trio in B-flat major, Hob. V:B1
items.notes: Two movements, Moderato and Tempo di minuet; authorship not proven (lettered Hoboken number)

items.title: String Trio in G major, Hob. V:G3
items.notes: Moderato, Tempo di minuet and Allegro; doubtful, but recorded under Haydn's name

items.title: String Trio in D major, Hob. V:D3
items.notes: Adagio, Minuet and Allegro finale; authorship not proven (lettered Hoboken number)
